chapter: Zach White, Cotton Pickers and Cab Calloway
title: Jimmie Lunceford takes the Cotton Club spot when Cab goes to Europe
summary: With Cab heading to Europe and Ellington on the road, Lunceford was auditioned at the Cotton Club and took the band's place, which launched him.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah, we're in the first part of '34. We're getting ready to go to Europe. In fact, Cab -- we were going to Europe, Duke Ellington was on the road, the Blue RHYTHM band was on the road and we didn't have a band to go into the Cotton Club.

So John Rushford came to New York and was playing the Lafayette Theater and he was tearing things up. So Cab went down there and heard him and had him come to the Cotton Club and make an audition. And he came in and took our place in the Cotton Club while we went to Europe. And he opened with the Hill Wynn Show (PHONETIC). That was Jimmie Lunceford break
